csv_project_name: DB For Bowling Center & F&B Upgrades
csv_agency: US Department of the Navy - Facilities Branch
csv_scope_of_work: The project includes all design and construction necessary to renovate and modernize the eight (8) lane Bowling Center (Bldg. 485) to include replacement of the existing pinsetter unit with new pinsetter unit to include string bowling, electronic gaming area and food operation described herein; including all demolition, installation, renovation, temporary construction and restoration necessary to produce a complete and useable facility.

title: Design-Build for Bowling Center and Food & Beverage Upgrades
short_description: Design-build renovation and modernization of an eight-lane bowling center in El Centro.
project_scope: Renovation and modernization of Bowling Center Building 485, including an eight-lane bowling facility. Scope includes replacement of the existing pinsetter system with a new string bowling pinsetter unit, addition of an electronic gaming area and food operation, plus all required demolition, installation, renovation, temporary construction, and restoration to deliver a complete usable facility.
services: Design-build services including architecture, rehabilitation/refurbishment, civil engineering, landscape architecture, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fire protection engineering, and inspection services.
relevance_explanation:
- Small building renovation project with low structural complexity.
- Focus is general building modernization rather than a demanding structural or long-span engineering task.
- Includes design-build and civil engineering components, but no clear special structural scope.
- Bowling/sports-related use is not enough to outweigh the limited engineering relevance for sbp.
- Military/Navy facility context further reduces strategic fit.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee stated in the source. Available information: design-build procurement, total construction cost 2.3 million USD, disciplines include architecture and engineering services; however, no reliable standalone sbp fee can be derived.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include architecture services, design-build/developer, landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, inspection services, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, and mechanical engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
